claim_boundary: This artifact closes sufficiently large height slack and extracts a divisor-class seed from survivors. It does not force subpower slack and proves no recurrence, full paired norm, endpoint, moment, density, or prime intervals.

fiber_saturation_theorem.amplified_jump: a survivor has Legendre margin 2tau+2j+2zeta-6rho, next denominator exponent 2tau-4rho+j+zeta, and next partial quotient exponent 2tau-6rho+2j+2zeta
fiber_saturation_theorem.boundary: no theorem forces zeta=o(1) in every survivor, and no recurrence, full paired norm, endpoint, moment, density, or prime intervals is proved
fiber_saturation_theorem.closure_threshold: the block closes if zeta exceeds both 2rho-1/3+mu and 3rho-tau+mu-1/30
fiber_saturation_theorem.divisor_seed: one class u|A, v|B with uv~H carries J X^{-epsilon} edges; there p=v*p0, q=u*q0 and the paired reduced labels are v*p0/(u*q0) and (A/u)*p0/((B/v)*q0), with signed tails retained
fiber_saturation_theorem.near_saturation: when zeta=o(1), that divisor class occupies an X^{-o(1)} fraction of its capacity JZ and is a genuine fiber-saturation seed
fiber_saturation_theorem.slack_parameter: write the actual multiplier height as H=N^2/(JZ), Z=X^zeta>=1
fiber_saturation_theorem.weighted_count: the exceptional weighted discretization and volume exponents are 4rho-2zeta and 3/5+6rho-2tau-2zeta

remaining_target.statement: couple the common divisor class and signed tails across popular differences to force a Cycle-126 recurrence seed
